rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_supervised-claude-agentic: lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=3, img_n_bf=2, epochs=8, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=20, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-12 (toward 20): KNOB=img_n_bf 1->2 (paired with proven proj_n_bf=3). Trend: every scalar flat at 0.9502 (lr 5e-3 peak, epochs flat, seed/loss/grad_clip flat); the ONLY knobs that moved SSIM moved it DOWN via image-domain over-smoothing (img_n_bf=15 -> 0.9333 discard, img_kernel=9 -> 0.9352 discard). img_n_bf was only ever tried at the extreme 15; the modest middle step 1->2 is untested. Hypothesis: a single image-domain BF under-denoises at 0.9502; a 2-filter image cascade adds just enough receptive field to lift SSIM without the over-smoothing collapse seen at depth 15.
